metadata.question: From August 3 to 9, 2009, did Southern Taiwan experience more rainfall than Northern Taiwan?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) or CHIRPS for rainfall data - GPM started in 2014, so for 2009 I need TRMM (Tropical Rainfall Measuring Mission) - TRMM 3B42 daily product: 'TRMM/3B42' covers 1998-2019 - Date: August 3-9, 2009 ('2009-08-03' to '2009-08-10') - Location: Define two regions - Northern Taiwan and Southern Taiwan 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation data - Just need to sum/average rainfall over the time period for each region 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Zero rainfall is valid (A or B depending on comparison) - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if pixel counts are zero (C2) - Check if results are None/null (C3) - Compare Southern vs Northern: if Southern > Northern, answer A; else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Northern and Southern Taiwan regions const northernTaiwan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[120.0, 25.5], [122.0, 25.5], [122.0, 24.5], [120.0, 24.5], [120.0, 25.5]] ]); const southernTaiwan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[120.0, 23.5], [121.0, 23.5], [121.0, 22.0], [120.0, 22.0], [120.0, 23.5]] ]); // 2. Get TRMM precipitation data for August 3-9, 2009 const startDate = '2009-08-03'; const endDate = '2009-08-10'; const trmm = ee.ImageCollection('TRMM/3B42') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const collectionSize = trmm.size().getInfo(); console.log(`TRMM Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No TRMM data available for the specified period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Calculate total rainfall for each region const totalRainfall = trmm.select('precipitation').sum(); // Northern Taiwan rainfall const northStats = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northernTaiwan, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const northCount = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: northernTaiwan, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Southern Taiwan rainfall const southStats = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southernTaiwan, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const southCount = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southernTaiwan, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Northern Taiwan valid pixels: ${northCount}`); console.log(`Southern Taiwan valid pixels: ${southCount}`); if (northCount === 0 || southCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } const northRainfall = northStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); const southRainfall = southStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Northern Taiwan avg rainfall (mm): ${northRainfall !== null ? northRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); console.log(`Southern Taiwan avg rainfall (mm): ${southRainfall !== null ? southRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); if (northRainfall === null || southRainfall === null || isNaN(northRainfall) || isNaN(southRainfall)) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 4. Compare rainfall if (southRainfall > northRainfall) { console.log(`Southern Taiwan (${southRainfall.toFixed(2)} mm) > Northern Taiwan (${northRainfall.toFixed(2)} mm)`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Southern Taiwan (${southRainfall.toFixed(2)} mm) <= Northern Taiwan (${northRainfall.toFixed(2)} mm)`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
